req.title: Player payload includes firstName and lastName
req.statement: The system shall include firstName and lastName fields on every player response.
triggers: player payload includes firstname and lastname

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-033 requires that every player response from GET /players/{id} includes firstName and lastName fields. The Pydantic model uses camelCase aliasing (to_camel), so the JSON response will contain 'firstName' and 'lastName' keys. Tests must: (1) verify a known player returns HTTP 200 with exact firstName and lastName values (positive/EP), (2) verify a non-existent UUID returns HTTP 404 and no player payload (negative/NEG), and (3) verify the boundary player (squad number 1, the first seeded row) returns correct firstName/lastName (BVA). Additional tests cover the last seeded row (BVA boundary), and assert exact field values to kill constant/field-name mutations.

preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
Player with id '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802' exists with firstName='Anjali', lastName='Banerjee'
expected: Response JSON contains key 'firstName' with value 'Anjali'
Response JSON contains key 'lastName' with value 'Banerjee'
trace: R-PLAYER-033: every player response must include firstName and lastName
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_get_player_by_id_includes_firstName_and_lastName_positive():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'firstName' in body
    assert 'lastName' in body
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
